problem_or_opportunity: Test whether the later HYPE-native deterioration can be improved by censoring long entries initiated during an explicit completed 15-minute TREND_DOWN context while preserving native short-onset exits.
why_now: The exact 14-trade live lineage showed all seven original entries in TREND_UP or RANGE and six of seven later entries in TREND_DOWN. That association was explicitly treated as post-observation and profile/time confounded rather than as a live rule.

mechanism_diagnosis.interpretation: The broader replay contradicts the 14-trade association: TREND_DOWN long entries were not the source of the aggregate loss and were materially profitable before largest-winner removal in the already-opened block. Censoring them damaged net return in both partitions. Development TREND_DOWN becomes negative after removing its largest winner, so this is not evidence to favor the context; it is evidence that the proposed censor is not justified.

decision.next_investigation: Continue prospective HYPE-native long-entry/short-exit observation with completed 15-minute context annotated, without gating. Diagnose attributable live lifecycles before proposing another entry filter.
